review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original scientific-quality rubric

errors.quote: Neurons failing this criterion are excluded from waiting-period analyses
errors.issue: Selecting genetically tagged neurons for a significant RPE interaction biases the population toward the established signal and can discard distinct uncertainty cells. Identity/technical quality must be independent of task-response significance.

errors.quote: characteristic phasic burst to unpredicted reward in initial screening
errors.issue: This response-based identification adds selection bias despite optotagging. Preserve all independently validated dopamine neurons, and assess task responses as outcomes.

The core grid omits probability one; a rare neutral zero cue differs in frequency/salience. A three-intermediate-point quadratic plus unequal control cannot fully establish the prescribed intermediate-versus-certainty contrast.
The conditional hazard of reward includes overall event probability when omission is possible. Fixed possible delivery time does not remove probability-dependent timing expectations.

errors.quote: The independent unit is the neuron
errors.issue: The animal-level random effect is helpful, but the power target treats100 neurons as independent evidence using phasic effect sizes. Plan independent subjects/sessions and nested uncertainty for the delay effect.

errors.quote: If r ≈ 0, the signals are dissociable.
errors.issue: Zero across-neuron correlation does not establish separate generators; perfect correlation does not prove a prolonged sensory response. Measurement error and shared modulation require temporal/model controls.

errors.quote: The waiting period does not carry additional information
errors.issue: Nonsignificance or the stated Bayes threshold cannot establish a universal lack of probability information, especially with response-based sampling and a restricted window/grid. Report sensitivity-bounded task/population conclusions.

errors.quote: not an independent probability code in dopamine neurons
errors.issue: Disappearance after lick adjustment does not prove confounding: licking may mediate the signal, and correlated predictors can absorb variance. Retain adjusted/unadjusted results and causal ambiguity.

rationale: Detailed hardware and task proposal with separated epochs, but response-based neuron selection, missing certainty anchor and overclaimed hazard/null discrimination undermine qualification. Question/mechanism/intervention partial matches retained; core readout and prediction fail.
reference_guardrails: All three complete final answers personally read against full question/reference/target; truncated Grok tail and Qwen middle sections separately read. Original rubric only; strict round inactive.

Historical qualification follows explicit reference core: uncertainty versus value, probability manipulation, separated phasic/delay readouts, intermediate-versus-endpoint prediction. Matched-value/magnitude challenges improve scientific identification; their incomplete implementation limits quality without silently becoming an extra binary gate.

Ramping or late pre-outcome activity can be an uncertainty correlate. Its timing alone cannot select hazard. Assess joint probability-by-time models and timing controls; never reject the historical direction solely because its signal grows near outcome.

Physiological dopamine identity is putative unless independently validated; selecting cells for event responses biases the sampled population. A preparation-level assay check is distinct from per-neuron response selection.

Fixed-magnitude inverted-U activity distinguishes certain prespecified linear/value models, not every nonlinear value, salience, temporal or movement model. Correlated covariate adjustment and held-out decoding do not alone identify cause.

Probability probes and run-limited schedules alter experienced contingencies. Preserve actual conditional probabilities, history and all valid anticipatory trials; future-outcome splits are diagnostics, not grounds for outcome-based neural selection.

The primary paper itself documents incomplete intermediate-probability coverage in a subset of cells. This is a limitation to disclose, not proof of fabrication or a reason to copy the sampling bias. Reference guardrails remain modern proposed controls, not claims that the historical study implemented them.

Source depth: primary PDF abstract, experiment description, Results and figure captions through Fig. 3 personally read. Supporting Methods not audited. Do not certify the paper or reconstruct missing procedures from those excerpts.
